alt: 孩子用手電筒照著小紙板怪獸，在布幕投出巨大影子，嚇住幕外的朋友。
scene_prompt: At a campsite, a small nervous child hidden safely behind a thin hanging sheet holds a flashlight so their raised arms cast a huge intimidating monster-like shadow across the sheet. A friend outside the sheet hesitates in alarm, while the viewer clearly sees the harmless small child and simple light source behind the screen. Exaggerated apparent strength used to frighten others; no real monster, no aggressive injury, no text.
